kill_switches.regime_flip: Nifty closes below 50-DMA → half size; below 50-DMA for 2+ weeks → STOP strategy entirely
kill_switches.fpi_reversal: FPI net sellers 3+ consecutive fortnights → stop buying their sectors
kill_switches.consecutive_losses: 3 consecutive stop-loss hits → pause 1 week + review
kill_switches.drawdown_limit: Cumulative paper losses > 8-10% of capital (Rs 320-400) → full stop, re-validate
kill_switches.expectancy_check: After every 20 completed paper trades compute expectancy = (win_rate x avg_win) - (loss_rate x avg_loss). Negative → stop + full re-backtest
kill_switches.scheduled_review: Weekly: regime check. Monthly: re-run multi-cutoff backtest. Quarterly: full re-validation
